program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (15.0, 10.0, 16.0),   # PMOS diff pair / tail / bias (weak inversion, headroom)
    "L_in":      (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),      # OTA device length (gain vs stage-1 pole)
    "I_tail":    (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),
    "gmid_load": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),    # NMOS mirror load
    "gmid_pass": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),     # pass device at ILOAD_MAX
    "L_pass":    (0.25, 0.15, 0.5),
    "N":         (100.0, 30.0, 200.0), # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "gmid_drv":  (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),     # NMOS transconductor at max drive
    "L_drv":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "Rdiv":      (240e3, 60e3, 600e3), # total divider resistance
    "Cout":      (1e-6, 2e-7, 1e-6),   # on-chip output capacitor
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vsup = 1.8
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 1e-4); imax = spec.get("iload_max", 1e-2)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)

    # ---- feedback divider ----
    beta = vref / vt
    R = p["Rdiv"]; R1 = R * (1 - beta); R2 = R * beta; idiv = vt / R
    Ipmax = imax + idiv; Ipmin = imin + idiv
    N = p["N"]

    # ---- pass device + diode (gate tracks supply) ----
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], p["L_pass"], Ipmax, vds=vsup - vt)
    vg = vsup - mp.vgs
    md = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], p["L_pass"], Ipmax / N, vds=mp.vgs)
    idrv_max = Ipmax / N
    mdrv = lut.size("n", p["gmid_drv"], p["L_drv"], idrv_max, vds=max(vg, 0.3))

    # ---- error amplifier: PMOS-pair 5T OTA, NMOS mirror load ----
    Ih = p["I_tail"] / 2
    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.8)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_load"], p["L_in"], Ih, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"], vds=0.3)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], iref, vds=0.9)
    mnb = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mn2 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MNB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MN2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    # OTA: vref -> diode side, fb -> output side
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vref", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "fb", "tail", "tail", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "n1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "n1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    # current-mode gate driver
    n.dev("MDRV", "g", "out1", "vss", "vss", mdrv)
    n.dev("MDIO", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", md)
    npf = max(1, min(200, int(math.ceil(mp.W / 100.0))))
    n.dev("MPASS", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=npf)
    # divider + output cap
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1); n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("COUT", "vout", "vss", p["Cout"])

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Ctot = p["Cout"] + cl
    G = A1 * beta * mdrv.gm * mp.gm / md.gm
    ugf = G / (2 * PI * Ctot)
    cg = mp.cgg + md.cgg + mdrv.cdd
    f_gate = md.gm / (2 * PI * cg)
    c1 = mdrv.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    f1 = (m1.gds + m3.gds) / (2 * PI * c1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / f1)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugf / f_gate))

    # driver gate voltage at minimum drive (bisection on forward model)
    idrv_min = Ipmin / N * 1.3
    lo, hi = 0.05, mdrv.vgs
    for _ in range(40):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op("n", mdrv.W, mdrv.L, mid, 1.0)["Id"] > idrv_min:
            hi = mid
        else:
            lo = mid
    vgs_min = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    dvg = mdrv.vgs - vgs_min
    load_reg = dvg / (A1 * beta) / (imax - imin) + 1.0 / G
    vos = max(abs(mdrv.vgs - m3.vgs), abs(vgs_min - m3.vgs)) / A1
    vout_err_pct = vos / beta / vt * 100

    gds_eff = mp.gds + mp.gm * mdrv.gds / md.gm
    w1k = 2 * PI * 1e3
    psrr = db(math.hypot(G, w1k * Ctot) / gds_eff)
    line_reg = gds_eff / G + 0.002
    iq = iref + iref + p["I_tail"] + idiv + idrv_min
    undershoot = 1.5 * (imax - imin) / (Ctot * 2 * PI * ugf) + (imax - imin) * 50e-9 / Ctot
    ripple = undershoot * math.exp(-2 * PI * ugf * 7e-6 * 0.5) + 1e-4

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err_pct, "load_reg": load_reg, "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq, "undershoot": undershoot, "overshoot": undershoot,
        "ripple_settled": ripple,
        "A1_db": db(A1), "ugf_max_hz": ugf, "f_stage1_hz": f1, "f_gate_hz": f_gate,
        "pm_deg": pm, "vgate_min": vg, "tail_headroom": vsup - (vref + m1.vgs) - mt.vdsat,
        "W_pass": mp.W,
    }

events.topology: PMOS-pass LDO, current-mode gate drive: PMOS-input 5T OTA -> NMOS transconductor -> PMOS diode mirrored 1:N into pass device, 1uF on-chip output cap (dominant output pole)
